sources.title: XRP Exchange Balances — October 31, 2026 08:00 UTC
sources.notes: Daily balances are read from XRPL via rippled account_info; exchange attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels. 22.48B XRP across 701 wallets and 24 exchanges. Includes cold storage, 37.8% unclassified, and 487.2M known non-customer reserves/funds. Same-wallet changes: all exchanges -133.0M 7d/-12.3M 30d; Binance +17.6M/+30.3M; Coinbase +17.7M/+18.4M. No per-wallet history; transfers to unlabelled wallets can appear as outflows.

sources.title: Binance replenishes 90% of assets stolen in security incident
sources.notes: Reuters reports Binance said 90% of stolen assets were replenished, remaining 10% are less-liquid tokens, partial SAFU deployment, and a 00:00 GMT Oct31 PoR snapshot for ten assets including XRP with minimum 1:1 backing once full proof is available; withdrawals targeted for Sunday Nov1. This reports Binance's claims, not independent reserve verification.

sources.title: B-Agent current-main, open-PR and workflow audit
sources.notes: Main 21ff522fe6457fb472e8140c180f0643b7948b29. 191 open PRs: 181 drafts, 10 ready; 189 target main and 2 another base. No main-based PR base.sha equals current main. Cross-analysis and scheduler-tick retain write permissions; Databricks token workflow accepts new_token and calls gh secret set; merge queue and paper trader are manual-only mutation workflows; automatic PR merge disabled. Full repository CI, dependency scan and branch-protection details incomplete/403.

independence_policy: XRP Insights is one aggregation source: direct rippled balance reads but XRPSCAN wallet labels. Reuters independently reports Binance's statement but does not independently verify reserves. GitHub REST observations are direct repository-state evidence.
